blocking_findings: Read capabilities are referenced but have no issuer, token, binding, expiry, or storage contract.
Two one-object uploads conflict with one top-level capability nonce and expiry in candidate evidence.
The pre-write dispatch receipt cannot also contain facts created by later public mutations; an append-only mutation receipt chain is undefined.
Broker, isolated runner, Vault, app wiring, DNS, TLS, network policy, availability, observability, and rollback ownership are not bounded enough to plan.
Administrator evidence validation is incorrectly combined with a prohibited repository integration-test dependency.
The candidate artifact and isolated-runner boundary has no reviewed implementation or executable protocol.
Current supply-chain candidate code still receives reusable Nexus credentials.
A public claim can be raced by a manually dispatched publisher because the exact returned publisher run is not bound by a coordinator-created receipt.
Publisher receipt binding lacks an exact signed-authorization read capability.
The immutable v0.6.13 workflow remains runnable with its historical OIDC and registry authority.
Broker APIs, capability tokens, object-key grammar, candidate evidence schema, and canonical archive fixtures are absent.
The 1000-suite horizon has no machine-detectable termination fixture.
The live-evidence schema and byte fixture are absent.
Tuple base64url expected values, workflow-to-job permission mapping, and total follow-up ordering remain incomplete.
No broker service, issuer, chart, DNS, TLS, OIDC validation, conditional object-store adapter, or live endpoint exists.
No destroyed-after-use runner, credentialless prefetch boundary, or singleton broker egress policy exists.
runner-config profiles are disabled and current egress policy is broader than the specified broker-only boundary.
Cross-repository GitOps, Vault, organization-runner, rollout, and validation dependencies are not explicit.

consensus.summary: All four exact-hash lanes reject v1.8. Preserve its forward-only and canonical-identity work, but make the broker/read/archive/receipt/old-workflow/platform contracts executable before code.
